title: Check ruling: the procedure value reconstitution rebinds to the concept as superseded
situation: The catalog re-cut's master comparison freezes the old gloss of the procedure value reconstitution; the reconstitution cut supersedes that concept, so its gloss now reads overview of each touched context first, then the detail needed from the journal and ledger, then readback before acting.
decision: Yes, under 0084's rule: a frozen check compares against the concepts and decisions in force, not the re-cut's master. That one expectation rebinds to the current gloss, seen to fail against the old catalog before it is frozen again.
consequences: Any further frozen expectation that differs from the master only because this cut supersedes what it names may be rebound by the lead under this rule, each seen red first, and listed in the cut's outcome.
